meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Reviewed the updated developer persistence skill and generated tool reference against the customer and owner runtime agents; neither tool allowlist receives campaign answers or mutation access.

auth.review_note: Checked campaign CSRF, session-bound submission token and owner Inbox authorization against existing login/account policy, including guest and customer access checks.

commerce.review_note: Reviewed the campaign additions against the order and catalogue contracts; campaign validation and owner CRM records do not enter commerce order, checkout or revenue processing.

content.review_note: Compared the revisioned campaign form, shared preview, receipt and error controls with the authored-page guide and the HTML autofocus rule for target fragments.

foundation.review_note: Reviewed the campaign HTTP controller and receipt redirect with session replay, admission and privacy boundaries. The isolated HTTP fixture verifies redirect, owner-only evidence and the existing error statuses.

google-tags.review_note: Compared the reconciled shared layout and public reporting guidance. The campaign form and receipt use the document body, while the existing page head supplies tags and metadata.

http-errors.review_note: Checked the native enquiry route failure handling against the HTTP response guard; unavailable writes are presented on-page and the campaign path logs a generic outcome.

interface.review_note: Verified the wrapped heading, aligned reading column and form, and native focus after validation and receipt alongside the error links and no-JavaScript controls.

mail.review_note: Compared actual Contact and Inbox projection, source metadata, duplicate receipt and zero automatic queue writes with public enquiry containment and the owner Inbox guide.

mcp-clients.review_note: Reviewed the revised Settings help alongside MCP client setup guidance. The change is confined to public Header menu guidance.

media.review_note: Checked admin skill changes against current header picker and stored upload contract; campaign form options stay with the page revision and create no media references.

operator-help.review_note: Checked the merged Pages guide against the header picker, disabled enquiry preview and revisioned editor, and matched Inbox campaign labels to the linked Contact and Inbox receipt.

public-mcp.review_note: Checked route inventories and PHP developer instructions against the public MCP allowlist; campaign POST and owner records have no MCP capability or discovery exposure.

remote-commerce.review_note: Checked the campaign form and receipt native navigation against the existing independent Checkout and Support payment paths.

sales-channels.review_note: Compared the MediaService additions with the Merchant Feed and product image inspection contracts. Header choices are filtered only for the owner authored editor, and catalogue image eligibility and feed URLs retain their existing resolution.

workflow.review_note: Preserved the dedicated campaign browser and HTTP gates and the main storefront checks. Regenerated map and index data from the combined route, service, schema and view sources.
